story.title: AI has access to a vastly larger working memory than the human brain

draft:
AI's working memory is now vastly larger than the human brain's. 
I've been reading about how this advantage is changing the game for mathematicians. 
Key implications include:
* Faster processing of complex equations
* Ability to analyze larger data sets
Can AI's enhanced memory capabilities augment human innovation or will it replace it?
#AI #Mathematics #Innovation
